note: D1 Spore Trail: mycelium_dash+ carries plant_origin, so the tile the tender leaves becomes growth once it is empty - the dash to the lone growth at (5,3) leaves a fresh growth tile at (1,3) behind it, and the second dash proves it by hopping straight back onto it (a growth-target ability can only aim at real growth). A dash that plants is an effective cast, so effective_uses counts mycelium_dash for the first hop; the return hop finds (5,3) still occupied by the growth it landed on and plants nothing
